name: robokalam-learner-os
description: Robokalam Learner OS — One Operating System for Every Learner.

scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: npm run migrate:prod -w server && (npm run seed:prod -w server || true) && node server/dist/server.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
